subject: Cross-functional preflight: issue triage & QBR asks
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-functional preflight: issue triage & QBR asks

Team —

We have 12 business days until the QBR readiness presentation and the executive ask list is coming in from Finance and Growth. I want a short cross-functional preflight to surface any open issues that could block launch readiness (GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support).

Please reply inline with one line for each of the following:
- Owner (your name)
- Readiness status (Green/Amber/Red)
- Top 2 blockers (short)
- Concrete ask (what you need from another team or leadership, with ETA)

Attaching the latest GTM_enablement_matrix.xlsx and pricing_brief_v2.pdf — use the matrix to map owners back to the QBR slides. I will consolidate and turn this into the one-pager for leadership.

Also: Tara from Arcadia is provisionally scheduled to begin a pilot on 6/21; if support or docs need to compress any timelines for that pilot, flag here.

Thanks — keep answers terse.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
VP, Go-to-Market Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GTM_enablement_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB); pricing_brief_v2.pdf (pdf, 560 KB)

Aisha —

Owner: Laura Bennett (Enablement)
Readiness: Amber
Top 2 blockers:
1) Slide deck for the enablement playbooks isn't finalized; SMEs have conflicting availability next week.
2) Classroom training schedule conflicts with the June hiring ramp.

Concrete ask:
- Can Product prioritize a single SME review window (2 hours) by 6/4 so we can lock content? If leadership can confirm SME owner, I can compress the deck finalization to 6/7.

Notes: I attached a draft of the support runbook sections that touch on enablement so folks can see the overlap — still rough but helpful for the QBR narrative.

Thanks,
Laura

Head of Enablement
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Cross-functional preflight: issue triage & QBR asks

Aisha / team —

Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Support & Ops)
Readiness: Amber
Top 2 blockers:
1) Support onboarding runbook has incomplete run rates for escalations; we need verification against real pilot traffic.
2) Tooling for CS routing (auto-assignment rules + escalation hooks) isn't fully configured in the sandbox — we're at ~70% of the desired rule set.

Concrete ask:
- Need a short 2-hour session with Arcadia's technical lead (Tara) next week (6/7–6/9 window) to validate escalation run rates — Tara, can you confirm availability?
- Karthik: can infra prioritize the remaining routing rules in the sandbox and give an ETA by EOD 6/3? This is blocking our ability to finalize support SLAs for the QBR.

Risk note: If we can't validate run rates before 6/10, we should call out a potential SLA delta for the pilot in the QBR and recommend a limited scope to mitigate exposure.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Support
Redwood Inference

Readiness: Green->Amber (depending on SME availability)
Top 2 blockers:
1) SME confirmation for enablement (Laura ask)
